fields.title: Article / latest-headline record
fields.description: Raw-passthrough dataset envelope. Every record carries _input/_source/_scrapedAt (failed URLs are not written to the dataset -- they are reported in the ERRORS record of the run's key-value store). Article-mode records (S1-html) spread the upstream ld+json NewsArticle/ReportageNewsArticle/Article node close to verbatim plus a scraped articleBody, so extra schema.org fields beyond those listed here may appear. Latest-mode records (S2-homepage) carry only title/link, scraped from the homepage's top-story links (not a true reverse-chronological feed).

_input.title: Input
_input.description: The exact input value (URL, or 'latest') that produced this record.

_source.title: Source strategy
_source.description: Which extraction strategy emitted this record (e.g. S1-html, S2-homepage).

_scrapedAt.title: Scraped at
_scrapedAt.description: UTC ISO 8601 timestamp when this record was scraped.

@type.title: Schema.org type
@type.description: Upstream ld+json node type: NewsArticle, ReportageNewsArticle, or Article.

articleBody.title: Article body
articleBody.description:
Full article text, joined from div.article-body > div.body-copy direct-child

tags (not present in the ld+json block itself).

author.title: Author
author.description: Author object(s) as emitted by upstream ld+json (raw passthrough).

creator.title: Creator
creator.description: Creator/byline array as emitted by upstream ld+json (raw passthrough).

keywords.title: Keywords
keywords.description: Comma-separated or array of keywords, as emitted upstream.

isAccessibleForFree.title: Accessible for free
isAccessibleForFree.description: Upstream metering flag -- observed to be consistently false even on articles with full text present in the HTML, so not a reliable paywall signal.

title.title: Title
title.description: Headline text, from the homepage top-story link's title attribute (latest mode).

link.title: Link
link.description: Article URL, from the homepage top-story link's href (latest mode).

overview.title: Overview
overview.description: Key columns across both article and latest-headline records.
